subject: Future Tech
title: Does AGI Need Consciousness?
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Does AGI Need Consciousness?.

hook.text: Can a machine be intelligent without being conscious? Or is awareness a prerequisite for real thinking?

buildup.text: Consciousness is subjective experience: the feeling of seeing red, tasting coffee, being excited.

discovery.text: Some researchers argue AGI only needs functional intelligence—solving problems, making plans—without inner experience.

twist.text: Others say understanding requires grounding in experience.

climax.text: We may build AGI long before solving consciousness.

quiz.question: Why is consciousness relevant to the AGI debate?
options: Some argue real understanding requires subjective experience
Laws require AI to be conscious
